//: Story Phase 2, chapter 6: Save Captain Squawks. Route: main hatch -> galley -> cargo hold stairs (14,4) -> Squawks in the Dead Center by the treasure door (4,5). The rope (tether) is re-tied on each map entry.
ch6.begin: hale[alarmed]: Captain, you can't go down there bare-faced! You'll drop before you reach the ladder!
rook: Take a line, Cap'n. I'll tie you on. If you go down, I'll haul you out.
fennimore[concerned]: And a wet cloth over your face. It won't stop the fumes, but it'll slow them. I'll soak one.

ch6.begin.tutorial: Get a line from Rook and a wet cloth from Doc Fennimore, then go down the main hatch. Squawks is in the Dead Center: follow his cries. Don't stay in thick fumes too long; clean or light air lets you recover.
ch6.begin.title: Rescue

ch6.rook_rope: rook: Bowline round the middle, and I've the other end. Two tugs means haul you up.
rook: So does going limp. I'll feel it.
ch6.doc_cloth: fennimore[concerned]: Here. Seawater and vinegar. Tie it over your nose and mouth.
fennimore: It'll slow the fumes, not stop them. Don't linger in the thick of it, Captain. I mean that.
ch6.gear_on: captain[determined]: Right. Squawks, you moth-eaten feather duster. I'm coming.

ch6.gear_on.tutorial: The wet cloth slows your Exposure. Head down the main hatch.
ch6.gear_on.title: Ready

then: rook[alarmed]: Not without a line, Cap'n! Come here and I'll tie you on!
fennimore[alarmed]: Captain! Not without a cloth over your face! Come and get one!
The galley is empty. Upturned bowls, a stew pot still bubbling on its own, and a yellow haze hanging at head height.
The hold is a yellow fog. Crates lie where the Gust flung them. Somewhere in it, a parrot is complaining.

then.say: garrick: CAPTAIN! A word of advice! Mind your BOOTS!
then.name: Garrick (from above)

then.say: garrick: Leather soaks it up! PERMANENTLY!
then.name: Garrick (from above)

then: captain[disgusted]: These are my best boots.

ch6.catch: Squawks is huddled against the treasure door: sooty, puffed up, and losing feathers with every shiver.
squawks[exhausted]: ...Captain? Is that you? You look like a bandit.
captain: It's a cloth. Come here.
Squawks bursts out of the fog in a blizzard of loose feathers, straight into your face.
squawks[exhausted]: Captain... my feathers... they're coming OUT...
captain[determined]: Hush. Hold on to me.

ch6.catch.tutorial: Carry Squawks back to the stairs. Rook will haul you both out.
ch6.catch.title: Got him!

ch6.hauled_out: You come up through the hatch like a sack of wet laundry, and land on the deck in a heap.
fennimore: Give them air! Everybody back!
Nobody says anything. Hale takes off his hat.
squawks[horrified]: MY FEATHERS! Where are my FEATHERS?!
fennimore[concerned]: The fumes took most of them, I'm afraid. They'll grow back. Probably. Eventually.
squawks[outraged]: I'm NAKED! In front of the CREW!
fennimore: Look at it this way. You came into the world with no feathers at all.
squawks[furious]: THEN PUT ME BACK IN THE EGG!
squawks[smug]: ...Obviously. I'm magnificent. Bald, but magnificent.
You look down. Your boots have gone the colour of an old bruise, and the smell has moved into them and signed a lease.
